name: EFC (I) Ltd
title: EFC (I) Ltd - 512008 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Flexible-workspace operator with strong FY26 growth (revenue +58%, PAT +67%), but working-capital build and right-issue funding raise cash-conversion questions; no capacity cut, capex stated as light.

capex.quote: we don't have any plans to kind of increase heavily on any CAPEX side

triggers.label: Rent per seat ₹7,000-7,250 → ₹7,250-7,500
triggers.quote: this financial year, on an average, we have already achieved 7,250 to 7,500

triggers.label: Working capital build in receivables, inventory
triggers.quote: working capital requirements increased particularly in trade receivables, inventories and other financial assets

triggers.label: D&B growth ~40%, Furniture >50% FY27
triggers.quote: about around 40% growth rate is fairly achievable

guidance.quote: about around 40% growth rate is fairly achievable
we would be able to grow over 50% growth rate under the Furniture vertical
we will be able to achieve 30% plus EBITDA
this business should generate to us anything around 25% EBITDA

prior_guidance_check.metric: Leasing seat additions 20,000-25,000 (FY26 prior guidance cited by analyst)

red_flags.label: Receivables and inventory build; equity raise framed as working capital
red_flags.quote: working capital requirements increased particularly in trade receivables, inventories and other financial assets

red_flags.label: Seat-count definitions shifted under questioning
red_flags.quote: there are different kind of ways people are explaining what is matured centers and what is an occupancy level

evasions.quote: So, Fenil, there is no shortfall.

evasions.topic: Why rights issue over debt or QIB
evasions.quote: debt is also there . I mean, if you see on the balance sheet , debt is also there .
